## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Tried in the demo (`demo/index.html`) or on the website (`npm run site`, then `_site/`)
- [ ] Checked with the keyboard, and with touch or a narrow window if the change affects them
- [ ] Tested in at least two browsers (Chromium plus Firefox or Safari)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README and `site/docs.html`) if options or behaviour changed
- [ ] No changes to `dist/`, `CHANGELOG.md` or version numbers
